title: Container with most water
statement:
Lines of height height[i] stand at x = i. Choose two lines that, with the x-axis, hold the most water; return that area (width × the shorter height).

Constraints: up to 10⁵ lines.
hints: Moving the taller line inward can never help: the area is capped by the shorter one. Move the shorter.

solution.explanation: Start at both ends. The area is width × min(h[i], h[j]). Moving the taller pointer inward shrinks the width and can't raise the min above the shorter line, so it can't improve; therefore move the shorter one. Every discarded pair is provably no better than one already considered, which is the exchange argument to give in an interview.
solution.python:
def max_area(height):
    i, j, best = 0, len(height) - 1, 0
    while i < j:
        best = max(best, (j - i) * min(height[i], height[j]))
        if height[i] < height[j]: i += 1
        else: j -= 1
    return best
